title: ribes sanguineum var. glutinosum
intro: Ribes sanguineum var. glutinosum, commonly known as Sticky Red Currant, is a deciduous shrub native to the mountainous regions of Europe. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Ribes sanguineum var. glutinosum include its ability to aid in wound healing, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
